text:
Ravi Patel: Hey team — I need to request a short-term accommodation for the next 6 weeks. I have recurring medical appointments on Tue mornings and need to shift my start time from 9am to 11am on those days. Also would like to upload a doctor note. Is there a confidential place to put that?
Jordan Lee: @Ravi thanks for flagging — we can probably cover the 9–11 overlap but want to make sure on-call rota and the weekly syncs are OK. Can you share which Tuesdays exactly?
Ravi Patel: Thanks @Jordan — next 6 weeks: 2026-04-06, 04-13, 04-20, 04-27, 05-04, 05-11. On-call is not scheduled those mornings. I'll DM the updated calendar invites.
Jordan Lee: Good. From a performance perspective, can we set up a weekly 15m check-in while this is in effect? Just to keep timelines visible. Not an escalation, just support.
Aisha Kaur (People Ops): Hi @Ravi — we can absolutely help. For confidentiality, please use the secure HR upload (one-time link below) or DM me if you prefer private email. The ADA interactive process applies; we'll need the medical note and a short description of the requested schedule.
Aisha Kaur (People Ops): Secure upload (expires 72h): https://hr.redwood.internal/secure-upload/ABC-2201112220
people-ops-bot: Upload ticket created: #HR-6421. Files uploaded to this ticket are visible only to People Ops and HR. Reply here when you’ve uploaded.
Ravi Patel: Uploaded the PDF to #HR-6421 — file name: "clinic-note_ravi_2026-03-28.pdf". Thanks.
Marta Chen (HR): I have the note and logged the accommodation request. Next steps: review for reasonableness (we usually approve schedule shifts like this) and draft a private accommodation agreement. A manager acknowledgement is needed; Jordan, we’ll send a short form to confirm coverage and any temporary adjustments.
Jordan Lee: Happy to sign. I'll also add the 15m weekly support check to my calendar starting next Tuesday.
Aisha Kaur (People Ops): Plan outline I’ll put in the private file: 1) Dates covered (Ravi listed) 2) Temporary schedule (Tue start 11am) 3) Coverage plan (Jordan confirmed) 4) Success criteria/check-ins (weekly 15m) 5) Review date (after 6 weeks). If anything changes, notify People Ops.
Ravi Patel: Appreciate it. Quick Q — will this be flagged in my profile or visible to the team?
Marta Chen (HR): It will be kept confidential in HR records and only shared with your manager and the accommodation admin. We won’t put anything in the public profile.
Jordan Lee: FYI I'll keep the team-level calendar as-is except for those Tue mornings; no public note.
Aisha Kaur (People Ops): Also note: if you prefer, we can add a private manager note to the HR system summarizing the agreement (non-public). I'll draft and post to #HR-6421.
Ravi Patel: Sounds good. thank you all. :pray:
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Please complete the "Accommodation Acknowledgement" form linked in ticket #HR-6421 within 48 hours to finalize. https://hr.redwood.internal/forms/accom-ack-6421
Jordan Lee: Done — signed the manager acknowledgement.
Ravi Patel: Form submitted. Thanks everyone — I feel better having a plan in place.
